map.输入参会人数、平均时薪与会议时长，计算这场会议的人力成本总额，帮助评估开会是否划: Enter attendees, average hourly wage and meeting duration to compute the meeting's total labor cost, helping judge whether it is worth holding and whether it can be trimmed.
map.总工时（人·小时） = 时长/60 × 参会人数；人力成本 = 总工时 × 人均: Total man-hours (person-hours) = duration/60 x attendees; labor cost = total man-hours x average hourly wage; total cost = labor cost + venue/equipment fee; cost per minute = total cost / duration (minutes); cost per head = total cost / attendees
map.会议的真实成本是\"所有人时间的机会成本\"，所以按人·小时而非自然时长计价。人: The true cost of a meeting is "the opportunity cost of everyone's time", so it is priced by person-hours rather than natural duration. Estimate hourly wages as annual salary divided by actual annual working hours (about 2000); for mixed-seniority meetings use a weighted average wage, otherwise executive attendance is understated. Cost per minute tells you "how much another 10 minutes is worth"; cost per head compares meetings of different sizes. The result is an estimate: it excludes hidden time such as follow-ups and material preparation, as well as travel and venue opportunity costs.
map.评估开会是否划算：输入参会人数、平均时薪与时长，算出这场会议的人力成本总额，量化: Evaluate whether a meeting is worth it: enter attendees, average hourly wage and duration to get the total labor cost, quantifying that "time is money".
map.优化会议管理：对比不同人数/时长的成本，推动精简参会者、压缩时长、用文档替代可不: Improve meeting management: compare costs across headcounts and durations to push trimming attendees, shortening meetings and replacing meetings that can be skipped with documents.
map.向管理层展示隐性成本：用具体金额说明低效会议对利润的影响，支撑流程改进。: Show management the hidden cost: state concrete amounts for how inefficient meetings hit profit, supporting process improvement.
map.：10 人、平均时薪 100 元、会 1 小时，人力成本 = 10×100×1: : 10 people at an average wage of 100 CNY/hour meeting for 1 hour gives a labor cost of 10 x 100 x 1 = 1000 CNY; weekly over 50 weeks a year, the hidden labor cost is about 50,000 CNY, still excluding opportunity cost and fatigue losses.
map.平均时薪怎么取才准？: How do I set the average hourly wage accurately?
map.用（月薪÷21.75÷8）估算日薪折算的时薪，或含五险一金与分摊管理成本的全成本: Use (monthly salary / 21.75 / 8) to estimate the hourly wage from the daily rate, or a full cost including social insurance, housing fund and allocated overhead; using base salary alone understates the true input.
